headline: The pit hits back: crates, barrels and loot in VIPER PIT
lede: Slot b's shift put destructible furniture and meter pickups into VIPER PIT — the never-dry weakest-stage pick — as a real seeded, hash-covered engine mechanic, shipped through 431 green checks with a self-biting mutant.

notes.text: VIPER PIT destructible props + pickups merged (PR #2341): seeded crates/barrels in the fight zone break under strikes and eat projectiles, kills can drop a +20 meter orb, layout seeds per round.
Warden target #1711 (PLAICRAFT S1) re-audited live: store unchanged at 7 graded takes, write key still unarmed, jonq #2305 awaiting — all remaining lines Jon-side; released to next with evidence.

A gait clause that passed on main went red on the branch for a real reason: the new orb economy legitimately shifts CPU engagement, and the clause had been riding a lucky passive window. Fixed honestly — sample the walk-out before engagement, widen the window; the law itself unchanged.
IRON RING stays bit-identical: the props option has zero hash footprint when off, pinned by golden streams computed against the pre-PR engine inside viperpitcheck.
